BasedOnStyle.description: Explicit base style; never discover .clang-format from a project.

IndentWidth.description: Spaces per indentation level. Unset inherits the selected base style.

ColumnLimit.description: Line width; 0 disables the column limit. Unset inherits the selected base style.

UseTab.description: Tab policy. Unset inherits the selected base style.

BreakBeforeBraces.description: Brace wrapping style. Unset inherits the selected base style.
